Of course! Our warranty policy depends on the product. Here’s a general overview for our main items: 📑

Mattresses

Our mattresses come with a Limited Lifetime Warranty for the original purchaser against manufacturing defects. Here’s how it works:

Years 1–10: We will repair or replace the mattress at no cost to you.
Years 11+: The coverage is prorated. For example, from years 11-15, a replacement would be 50% of the current retail price.

Covered defects include:

Indentations or sagging greater than 1.5 inches.
Physical flaws in the foam or springs.

Please note that stains will void the warranty, and it does not cover normal wear and tear or comfort preference.

Ascension™ Luxe Adjustable Power Base

The adjustable base has a 10-year warranty on workmanship and materials, but it excludes electronic components like motors, the control box, and remote controls. For any warranty claims on the adjustable base, you would need to contact the manufacturer, Ergomotion, directly at 1-888-550-3746.

To file a warranty claim for a mattress purchased on our website, you can email warranty@brooklynbedding.com with your proof of purchase and photos of the defect.
